settings.files.title: Projects to send
settings.files.hint: Ticked projects upload when their files stop changing. Nothing is ever deleted on the other side.
settings.files.ignores.hint: Comma separated, in addition to .git, node_modules, .venv, dist, build and the project’s .gitignore.

trust.title: This project received files over sync
trust.detail:
Running it executes commands this folder defines — npm scripts, run.sh, or a Python interpreter inside it. Those arrived from the sync server, not from you.

{path}
trust.detail.terminal:
Opening it starts your agent with this folder as its working directory, and the agent reads and acts on what it finds there. These files arrived from the sync server, not from you.

{path}
trust.declined: Not opened — the project is still waiting to be approved.
settings.pull.title: Projects to receive
settings.pull.hint: These arrive on their own when the other machine sends them. They land in your projects folder and appear in the rail.
settings.portable.title: Move your setup by file
settings.portable.hint: Memory, CLAUDE.md and preferences as one file you can carry to another machine. No server needed.
settings.pull.none: Nothing offered by another machine yet.
settings.pull.received: Received {slug} — {n} files written. It needs approving before it runs.
settings.td.title: Your TabDesk
settings.td.none: This device does not belong to a TabDesk yet. Create one, or join the one your other machine already has.
settings.td.nokeyring: No desktop keyring available, so a group key cannot be stored safely here. Sync stays off.
settings.td.member: This device belongs to a TabDesk.
settings.td.recovery.lead: Write this down and keep it somewhere safe.
settings.td.recovery.warn: It is the only way back to your data if you lose every device. Nobody — not the server, not us — can recover it for you.
settings.td.invite.lead: Paste this into TabDesk on the other machine.
settings.td.invite.warn: Treat it like a password — it gives full access until it expires.
settings.td.invite.expired: Expired — press Add a device for a new one.
settings.td.join.lead: Paste the invite from the machine that already has your TabDesk.
settings.td.join.replaces: ⚠ This replaces the key this device already has — anything only it could read becomes unreadable.
settings.td.err.not-invite: That is not a TabDesk invite.
settings.td.err.damaged: The invite is damaged — copy it again in full.
settings.td.err.expired: That invite has expired. Make a new one on the other machine.
settings.td.err.version: That invite was made by a different version of TabDesk.
settings.td.err.exists: This device already belongs to a TabDesk.
settings.td.err.not-pinned: Accept the server’s key first, under Server details.
settings.td.err.keyfile: The key file could not be read.
settings.td.err.no-keyring: No desktop keyring — the key cannot be stored.
settings.td.err.incomplete: Set up the server first — missing: {fields}. Open Server details below.
